chunks: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to me from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the Ziyarah (visitation) of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him). He said: 'What is its virtue? It is equal to an 'Umrah.'

key_terms.زِيَارَة: Visitation or pilgrimage to a shrine

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam Husayn?
ai.summary: In Kamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qulawayh records Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) declaring that the spiritual reward of visiting the shrine of Imam al-Husayn (peace be upon him) equals that of an 'Umrah, highlighting the unique status of the Ahl al-Bayt's resting places as centers of divine grace. This comparison elevates the Ziyarah from a mere act of remembrance to a significant ritual of worship, often interpreted by Shia scholars as indicating that the devotion shown to the Imams carries the weight of pilgrimage to the Kaaba, thereby bridging the gap between local devotion and universal Islamic practice.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 8. Muḥammad ibn Ja’far narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain, from Safwān ibn Yaḥyā, who said:
I asked Abal Ḥasan (Imam Riďā (a.s.)) about the reward for going to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.). Imam (a.s.) said, “It is equal to performing an ‘Umrah.”
